```{r}
install.packages(c("hexSticker", "ggplot2"))

library(ggplot2)
library(hexSticker)

# Datos ejemplo
set.seed(123)
df <- data.frame(
  tratamiento = rep(c("A", "B", "C"), each = 20),
  valor = c(rnorm(20, 12, 2),
            rnorm(20, 12, 2),
            rnorm(20, 12, 2))
)

# Gráfico base
p <- ggplot(df, aes(tratamiento, valor)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = NA,
    color = "white",
    width = 0.45,
    size = 0.3,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.12,
    size = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.35,
    color = "#CFE8E3"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

sticker(
  subplot = p,
  package = "AGROBOX",
  p_size = 10,
  p_color = "white",
  p_x = 1,
  p_y = 1.5,
  s_x = 1,
  s_y = 0.9,
  s_width = 1.2,
  s_height = 1.2,
  h_fill = "#0B2E26",   # verde más profundo
  h_color = "#BFD8D2",  # borde más suave
  h_size = 3,
  filename = "agrobox_hex.png"
)


```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(hexSticker)

set.seed(123)

df <- data.frame(
  tratamiento = rep(c("A", "B", "C"), each = 20),
  valor = rnorm(60, 12, 2)
)

# Datos para burbujas de fondo
bg <- data.frame(
  tratamiento = sample(c("A","B","C"), 12, replace = TRUE),
  valor = runif(12, min(df$valor)-1, max(df$valor)+1),
  size = runif(12, 8, 20)
)

p <- ggplot(df, aes(tratamiento, valor)) +

  # 🔵 Fondo burbujas (mismo eje discreto)
  geom_point(
    data = bg,
    aes(tratamiento, valor, size = size),
    color = "#1F5A4C",
    alpha = 0.15,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  # 📦 Boxplot
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = NA,
    color = "white",
    width = 0.45,
    size = 0.4,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +

  # 🔬 Jitter
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.12,
    size = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.35,
    color = "#CFE8E3"
  ) +

  scale_size_identity() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0))

sticker(
  subplot = p,
  package = "AGROBOX",
  p_size = 9,
  p_color = "white",
  p_x = 1,
  p_y = 1.6,
  s_x = 1,
  s_y = 1,
  s_width = 1.55,
  s_height = 1.55,
  h_fill = "#0B2E26",   # verde más profundo
  h_color = "#BFD8D2",  # borde más suave
  h_size = 3,
  filename = "agrobox_hex_2.png"
)
```
